text:
marta: Quick PSA — infra PRs touching k8s/ manifests are not getting Atlantis plans. CI shows infra-lint passing but no plan step. Anyone seen this?
raj: Yep, saw two PRs last night where atlantis didn't pick up changes. Looks like the workflow path filter only watches terraform/** and charts/**. k8s/ was new and omitted.
marta: That explains it. We added k8s/ for pure manifests. Do we want GHA to trigger Atlantis or have Atlantis detect it directly?
leo: Atlantis needs repo config updated too (repos.yaml currently maps only infra/terraform/*). We'll need entries for k8s/staging and k8s/prod.
jen: Heads-up — if we let both GHA and Atlantis trigger, we get duplicate plans and noise. I'd prefer a single source of truth: Atlantis handles plan/apply, GHA should only dispatch when explicitly asked.
atlantis-bot: queued plan for dir: k8s/staging on PR #762
ci-bot: GH Actions started: infra-lint (run #1245) — status: in_progress
raj: Proposed change: add label gating to the GHA workflow so dispatch to Atlantis only happens when PR has label 'atlantis-plan'. That avoids accidental runs. Also update repos.yaml to include the k8s dirs.
marta: Label gating sounds safe. I'll draft the workflow.
leo: We also need secrets for dispatch (ATLANTIS_WEBHOOK or ATLANTIS_TOKEN). Org secret exists in vault, but repo-level secret not set. I'll request it from infra-kms.
jen: Another wrinkle: ArgoCD auto-sync will pick up changes after merge. For k8s/ we should ensure ArgoCD apps are set to manual sync or have a sync window until we validate the applied changes. We don't want staging to auto-deploy half-baked manifests.
raj: Agreed — sequence should be: atlantis plan -> atlantis apply -> gitops commit or push -> ArgoCD picks up. If ArgoCD auto-syncs the source repo directly, we need to gate that.
marta: Plan: 1) Add label gating to .github/workflows/atlantis-dispatch.yml, 2) Update repos.yaml to include k8s/*, 3) Provision secrets for dispatch, 4) Add pre-merge requirement that atlantis plan succeeded, 5) Adjust ArgoCD app to disable auto-sync for k8s/staging until rollout tests pass.
leo: I'll request ATLANTIS_WEBHOOK in the org vault and create a repo secret. ETA EOD.
jen: I'll add the required branch protection rule blocking merges when atlantis plan is missing/failed.
raj: Quick sample for the workflow I'm thinking of:
```yaml
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  dispatch:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'atlantis-plan')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch to Atlantis
        uses: actions/http-client@v1
        with:
          url: '${{ secrets.ATLANTIS_WEBHOOK }}'
          method: 'POST'
          headers: '{"Content-Type":"application/json"}'
          body: '{"pr": "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"}'
```
raj: Might need retry/backoff and to mask secrets.
marta: I'll open two PRs: one for the workflow change and one for repos.yaml. Assigning reviews to @raj and @leo.
leo: Reviewing and will follow up on the secret request.
atlantis-bot: Plan completed for PR #762 — 2 projects to plan; no changes to apply.
marta: Great, thanks. Closing this thread for now — will post updates when PRs land and the secret is in place. :thumbsup:
